newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AFRICAN LIFE IN 50 MLN RAND UK ASSET SWAP.
newsitem.headline: AFRICAN LIFE IN 50 MLN RAND UK ASSET SWAP.

text.p: South Africa's African Life Assurance Co Ltd said on Friday it had concluded a 50 million rand asset swap with UK's Prudential Portfolio Managers on a limited offer basis.
African Life said in a statement the arrangement enabled it to offer investors a five-year single premium endowment which would be invested in a selection of unit trusts around the world.
"The Prudential, which has assets under management of over $150 billion, is offering a choice of five unit trusts under the Global Growth Portfolio," it said.
The unit trusts -- the UK Equity Trust, the European Trust, the North American Trust, the Japanese Trust and the Pacific Markets Trust -- had yielded good returns over a five year period.
"Through the Global Growth Porfolio, investors will have access to over 600 shares worldwide through purely equity based funds," African Life said.

It said the funds were managed on location and would provide investors with stable returns, a rand hedge opportunity, risk diversification on a global basis and "an investment uninfluenced by local socio-economic conditions".
African Life has assets of just over one billion rand.
